2608.23217.title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction: Benchmarking Neural Architectures and Validation on EXL-50U
2608.23217.paper_summary: Fast and reliable plasma equilibrium prediction is essential for real-time tokamak operation and control, but conventional Grad-Shafranov (GS) solvers are often too costly for real-time deployment. We develop an AI surrogate framework and benchmark five architectures (MLP, CNN, FNO, Transformer, and KAN) on a numerical GS database with 100,000 IID and 10,000 OOD samples. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate accuracy, inference efficiency, model scaling, and robustness. We also establish device-level validation on the EXL-50U tokamak by linking numerical GS solutions, surrogate predictions, and the standard Shape Editor reference to assess simulation-to-device consistency. The surrogates achieve errors of $10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$ relative to GS solutions, while the GS-to-device discrepancy remains at $10^{-3}$. Transformer gives the best IID accuracy, whereas CNN offers the best balance of accuracy, robustness, and speed, reaching 0.7 ms TensorRT latency. On unseen plasma geometries and parameter regimes, CNN and FNO show the strongest extrapolation stability, with 4%-5% relative $L_2$ error, while models with weaker inductive biases degrade more substantially. Scaling data and model capacity improves interpolation but not necessarily extrapolation, revealing a trade-off between capacity and OOD generalization. Overall, this work provides a systematic, device-consistent benchmark for AI-based GS prediction and practical guidance for selecting reliable surrogates for real-time plasma control and fusion applications.
2608.23217.paper_summary_zh: 快速且可靠的等離子體平衡預測對於實時托卡馬克操作和控制至關重要，但傳統的Grad-Shafranov (GS) 解算器通常成本過高，無法實時部署。<lb/>我們開發了一個AI替代框架，並在一個擁有100,000個獨立同分佈（IID）樣本和10,000個超出分佈（OOD）樣本的數值GS數據庫上基準測試了五種架構（MLP、CNN、FNO、Transformer和KAN）。<lb/>在統一的協議下，我們評估了準確性、推理效率、模型擴展性和穩健性。<lb/>我們還通過將數值GS解、替代預測和標準形狀編輯器參考鏈接起來，建立了在EXL-50U托卡馬克上的設備級驗證，以評估模擬與設備的一致性。<lb/>替代模型相對於GS解的誤差達到$10^{-3}$-$10^{-2}$，而GS與設備之間的差異保持在$10^{-3}$。<lb/>Transformer提供了最佳的IID準確性，而CNN則在準確性、穩健性和速度之間提供了最佳平衡，達到0.7毫秒的TensorRT延遲。<lb/>在未見過的等離子體幾何形狀和參數範圍下，CNN和FNO顯示出最強的外推穩定性，相對$L_2$誤差為4%-5%，而具有較弱歸納偏見的模型則顯著降級。<lb/>擴展數據和模型容量改善了插值，但不一定改善外推，揭示了容量和OOD泛化之間的權衡。<lb/>總體而言，這項工作為基於AI的GS預測提供了一個系統的、設備一致的基準，並為選擇可靠的替代模型以實現實時等離子體控制和融合應用提供了實用指導。
